proposed_construct: HHH syndrome due to SLC25A15 mitochondrial ornithine transporter deficiency, impairing matrix ornithine entry for the urea cycle and causing hyperornithinemia, hyperammonemia, and homocitrullinuria
proposed_objective: Localize ornithine transport to the mitochondrial inner membrane and connect SLC25A15 deficiency with impaired urea-cycle flux and homocitrulline formation.

proposed_construct: Lysinuric protein intolerance due to SLC7A7 basolateral cationic amino acid transport deficiency in intestine and kidney, causing low plasma lysine arginine ornithine and secondary hyperammonemia after protein
proposed_objective: Distinguish defective intestinal and renal cationic amino-acid export from an intrinsic urea-cycle enzyme deficiency.

proposed_construct: Sitosterolemia due to ABCG5 or ABCG8 loss causing impaired intestinal and biliary sterol efflux with accumulation of plant sterols
proposed_objective: Connect ABCG5/ABCG8 sterol efflux failure with phytosterol accumulation, xanthomas, and hematologic abnormalities.

proposed_construct: Cerebrotendinous xanthomatosis due to CYP27A1 sterol 27-hydroxylase deficiency causing reduced chenodeoxycholic acid synthesis and cholestanol accumulation
proposed_objective: Link CYP27A1 deficiency to defective bile-acid synthesis and tissue cholestanol deposition.

proposed_construct: I-cell disease due to GNPTAB deficiency of N-acetylglucosamine-1-phosphotransferase, preventing mannose-6-phosphate tagging of lysosomal hydrolases and causing extracellular secretion
proposed_objective: Explain why lysosomal enzymes are elevated extracellularly but deficient inside lysosomes when mannose-6-phosphate tagging fails.

proposed_construct: Primary hyperoxaluria type 1 due to AGXT alanine-glyoxylate aminotransferase deficiency in peroxisomes, shunting glyoxylate toward oxalate
proposed_objective: Connect peroxisomal glyoxylate detoxification failure with calcium oxalate nephrolithiasis and systemic oxalosis.

proposed_construct: Multiple acyl-CoA dehydrogenase deficiency due to ETFA ETFB or ETFDH defects interrupting electron transfer from flavoprotein dehydrogenases to coenzyme Q
proposed_objective: Explain why one electron-transfer defect produces abnormalities across multiple fatty-acid and amino-acid oxidation pathways.

proposed_construct: Riboflavin transporter deficiency due to SLC52A2 or SLC52A3 loss producing functional flavoprotein deficiency with motor neuropathy and multiple-acyl-CoA-dehydrogenase-like biochemical findings
proposed_objective: Connect riboflavin transport to FAD/FMN-dependent energy metabolism and neurologic disease.

proposed_construct: Molybdenum cofactor deficiency causing combined loss of sulfite oxidase and xanthine dehydrogenase activities with neonatal encephalopathy, sulfite accumulation, and low uric acid
proposed_objective: Use the shared molybdenum cofactor requirement to explain simultaneous abnormalities in sulfur amino-acid and purine metabolism.

proposed_construct: MPI-CDG due to mannose phosphate isomerase deficiency, impairing conversion of fructose-6-phosphate to mannose-6-phosphate for N-linked glycosylation
proposed_objective: Connect mannose-phosphate isomerase deficiency with defective N-glycosylation and the biochemical rationale for oral mannose therapy.

proposed_construct: LCAT deficiency causing impaired esterification of free cholesterol on HDL, abnormal lipoprotein maturation, corneal opacity, hemolytic anemia, and progressive renal disease
proposed_objective: Explain the role of LCAT in HDL maturation and reverse cholesterol transport.

proposed_construct: Apolipoprotein C-II deficiency causing failure to activate lipoprotein lipase and severe chylomicronemia despite structurally normal LPL
proposed_objective: Distinguish an essential LPL cofactor deficiency from loss of the lipase enzyme itself.

proposed_construct: Plasminogen activator inhibitor 1 deficiency due to SERPINE1 loss causing excessive fibrinolysis and delayed bleeding despite normal PT and aPTT
proposed_objective: Connect failure to inhibit tissue plasminogen activator with premature clot lysis.

proposed_construct: Alpha-2-antiplasmin deficiency due to SERPINF2 loss causing failure to neutralize plasmin and delayed post-traumatic bleeding with normal routine coagulation tests
proposed_objective: Differentiate impaired plasmin inhibition from defects of fibrin generation.

proposed_construct: Factor XIII deficiency causing failure of fibrin cross-linking after thrombin-mediated fibrin formation, producing unstable clots despite normal PT and aPTT
proposed_objective: Identify factor XIII as the transglutaminase that cross-links fibrin after the conventional coagulation assays have reached their endpoints.

proposed_construct: Gray platelet syndrome due to NBEAL2 deficiency causing absent platelet alpha granules, large gray platelets, thrombocytopenia, and progressive marrow fibrosis
proposed_objective: Link alpha-granule biogenesis failure to the characteristic platelet morphology and bleeding phenotype.

proposed_construct: Leukocyte adhesion deficiency type II due to SLC35C1 GDP-fucose transporter deficiency causing absent fucosylated sialyl-Lewis X and impaired selectin-mediated leukocyte rolling
proposed_objective: Distinguish defective selectin-ligand fucosylation from integrin activation defects in leukocyte extravasation.

proposed_construct: IRAK4 deficiency impairing TLR and IL-1 receptor signaling with weak NF-kappaB inflammatory responses, recurrent pyogenic infection, and blunted fever and CRP
proposed_objective: Connect MyD88-IRAK4 innate signaling failure with invasive bacterial infection despite muted inflammatory signs.

proposed_construct: DOCK8 deficiency impairing actin cytoskeletal remodeling in lymphocytes and causing combined immunodeficiency with severe cutaneous viral infections, allergy, and high IgE
proposed_objective: Differentiate DOCK8 deficiency from STAT3 hyper-IgE syndrome using antiviral immunity and cytoskeletal function.

proposed_construct: APECED due to AIRE loss causing failure of medullary thymic epithelial cells to express peripheral tissue antigens and defective deletion of autoreactive T cells
proposed_objective: Connect AIRE-dependent ectopic antigen expression with central T-cell tolerance.

proposed_construct: Bare lymphocyte syndrome type II due to defects in CIITA or RFX transcriptional regulators causing absent MHC class II expression and impaired CD4 T-cell development
proposed_objective: Explain how loss of MHC II transcription disrupts positive selection and helper T-cell immunity.

proposed_construct: Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome due to defective lysosome-related organelle biogenesis causing absent platelet dense granules and oculocutaneous albinism
proposed_objective: Unify pigment dilution and bleeding through a shared lysosome-related organelle trafficking defect.

proposed_construct: Niemann-Pick disease type C due to NPC1 or NPC2 defects in lysosomal cholesterol egress causing intracellular unesterified cholesterol accumulation and vertical supranuclear gaze palsy
proposed_objective: Distinguish defective intracellular cholesterol trafficking from lysosomal sphingomyelin degradation defects.

proposed_construct: Congenital disorder of glycosylation from phosphomannomutase 2 deficiency, reducing mannose-1-phosphate and GDP-mannose synthesis for N-linked glycosylation
proposed_objective: Connect PMM2 deficiency to deficient glycoprotein assembly and multisystem disease.
